title: MoleculesAI Container Image Registry SSOT
description: SSOT JSON-Schema (draft 2020-12) for contracts/registry.yaml — the single source of truth for the CONTAINER IMAGE REGISTRY every image reference derives from (host/owner/prefix, box auth SHAPE, the runtime env var + CI org var derivation seams, the keep-N retention policy, and the optional dynamic pull-through mirror). Distinct from cloudproviders.yaml (compute backends) and the LLM provider registry. tools/gen-registry.mjs emits gen/registry/registry.env + gen/go/registry/registry.go from the validated instance; .gitea/workflows/registry-ssot-drift.yml pins gen/ to this contract.

version.description: Schema/data revision of this contract instance.

prefix.description: Canonical host[/owner] every image ref formats against. MUST equal '<host>/<owner>'.

push_host.description: Optional CF-bypass push endpoint (host:port). Empty when pushes go to `host` directly.

env_var.description: Env var Go runtime consumers (CP + core RegistryPrefix) read to override `prefix`.

ci_var.description: Gitea Actions org/repo variable CI publishers derive IMAGE_NAME from (fallback `prefix`).

ci_push_host_var.description: Gitea Actions variable overriding `push_host` for CI publishers.

keep_max_versions.description: Max versions kept per container package before older ones are pruned.

keep_tags.description: Tag values whose version is never pruned (moving prod/staging heads).

pinned_exempt.description: When true, a version whose digest is pinned (pin_source) is never pruned.

prune_untagged.description: Untagged/dangling upload versions are always eligible for prune.
